title: Unbounded Array Length in Unlock Request Schema (Backend DoS)
description: The requestUnlockSchema accepts arrays for `blockedCategories` and `blockedKeywords` without specifying a maximum length. An attacker can send extremely large arrays, causing V8 memory exhaustion during `join(', ')` or payload rejection by the email provider, leading to Denial of Service.

title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in MetaDescriptionFetcher
description: The SmartScan feature fetches arbitrary URLs provided by the accessibility service. There is no validation to prevent requests to local/private IP addresses (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x). An attacker could craft a webpage with iframes or redirects to internal services, causing the app to send requests to local network devices.

title: Rate Limiting Bypass via IP Rotation
description: The `otpLimiter` in the Express backend restricts requests based on IP address. An attacker can use a proxy pool to rotate IPs and spam a victim's email address with OTP requests, completely bypassing the intended 5 requests/15min limit. It also creates a risk of blocking legitimate users sharing an IP (NAT).
